question: Should OpenClaw add native subagent context-pressure escalation, and if so should it notify only the parent session, the operator channel, or also trigger recovery/alternate routing?
rationale: The source shows no existing threshold or escalation contract, and the requested fix would add product semantics for thresholding, parent identity, notification routing, and recovery behavior.

options.title: Add observe-only parent/operator alert
options.body: Define a context-pressure threshold and emit a diagnostic/session event plus parent/operator notification, leaving recovery manual until live behavior is proven.

options.title: Add automatic recovery routing
options.body: Let saturated child sessions trigger parent-routed recovery or alternate-specialist routing, accepting a larger orchestration policy surface.

options.title: Keep as external monitoring
options.body: Document this as fleet-specific monitoring for now and avoid adding a native core contract.

recommendation.title: Add observe-only parent/operator alert
recommendation.body: Define a context-pressure threshold and emit a diagnostic/session event plus parent/operator notification, leaving recovery manual until live behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The open diagnostics context-pressure work makes vincentkoc the clearest current routing owner for deciding the diagnostic/event alert shape.
